name: win31-tetris
description: A Tetris implementation styled after the Windows 3.0 Entertainment Pack Tetris, with a full modern Tetris Guideline ruleset. Custom engine, raw WebGL renderer, zero runtime dependencies.

scripts.test: esbuild test/engine.selftest.ts --bundle --outfile=/tmp/win31tetris-t1.js --platform=node --target=es2019 && node /tmp/win31tetris-t1.js && esbuild test/board-tspin.selftest.ts --bundle --outfile=/tmp/win31tetris-t2.js --platform=node --target=es2019 && node /tmp/win31tetris-t2.js && esbuild test/music.selftest.ts --bundle --outfile=/tmp/win31tetris-t3.js --platform=node --target=es2019 && node /tmp/win31tetris-t3.js
